title: incident-bot: add automated SLO diagnostics and runbook generation (slo-toolkit integration)
author: Aisha Patel
ci_status: pass (build ✅, unit tests ✅, integration flaky tests rerun ✅)
description: Adds an automated SLO diagnostics pipeline to incident-bot and a runbook generation helper that integrates with slo-toolkit. Motivation: on-call responders spend time manually collecting SLO context and basic diagnostics during incidents. This PR introduces a diagnostics runner that aggregates the relevant SLO state, recent burn-rate traces, and failing symptom logs, then produces a templated runbook entry (markdown) and a short summary message suitable for Slack/incident channels. The implementation is opt-in and guarded by a feature flag (SLO_AUTO_DIAGNOSTICS). The change touches the incident-bot service, adds a new helper in slo-toolkit for runbook templates, and includes unit and integration tests. See linked Linear tickets ENG-5421 (SLO diagnostics) and ENG-5480 (runbook templates).

release_notes:
- incident-bot: automated SLO diagnostics and templated runbook generation (opt-in via SLO_AUTO_DIAGNOSTICS)
- slo-toolkit: runbook_generator helper for templated runbooks
- Adds PII scrubber and team opt-out configuration
additional_context: This is an opt-in feature behind SLO_AUTO_DIAGNOSTICS. Default is off for all customers. Follow-up work: hook diagnostics into alerting rules and add pager rotations (ENG-5602). Backport: none required.
notes_for_oncall: If diagnostics run is triggered, check /v1/diagnose response in incident-bot admin UI. If runbook includes PII unexpectedly, disable SLO_AUTO_DIAGNOSTICS and open a security incident. For high-frequency alerts, diagnostics will sample at 1/min by default; configure rate in incident-bot config.
